dedupe_keys.name: two stage global photovoltaic classification scripts

description: The global photovoltaic mapping research team publishes scripts for a two-stage panel-classification workflow. Python files prepare labels and call U-Net training or prediction; Earth Engine JavaScript constructs Sentinel-2 features, trains random forests, adjusts positive-unlabelled probabilities and cleans classified images. Coverage supports the associated global 2019–2022 mapping work. Public source is free under MIT and can help prepare photovoltaic inventories for infrastructure simulations alongside data-global-power-plant-database. A caveat is that the deposit is not a complete executable environment: Python imports reference absent nets and utils modules, and Earth Engine scripts require user-supplied sample and region objects. Reusable processing stages therefore need integration and checking before use. Execution may require an Earth Engine account, but public source inspection did not. No classification or model training was run.
